story.text: 어젯밤 흑돼지에 회까지 욕심껏 먹은 게 화근이었는지, 아침부터 속이 더부룩하고 메스꺼웠다. 아무래도 체한 것 같았다.
story.reading: eo-jet-bam heuk-dwae-ji-e hoe-kka-ji yok-sim-kkeot meog-eun ge hwa-geun-i-eot-neun-ji, a-chim-bu-teo sog-i deo-bu-ruk-ha-go me-seu-kkeo-wot-da. a-mu-rae-do che-han geot gat-at-da.
story.en: Whether it was the black pork or the sashimi I'd greedily eaten too much of the night before, my stomach felt bloated and queasy from the moment I woke up. It seemed like I'd definitely gotten indigestion.

story.text: 얼굴이 하얗게 뜬 나를 보자마자 용우의 표정이 굳었다. '얼굴이 왜 그래. 어디 아프냐?' 손으로 내 이마를 짚어보며 다급하게 물었다.
story.reading: eol-gul-i ha-yat-ge tteun na-reul bo-ja-ma-ja yong-u-ui pyo-jeong-i gud-eot-da. eol-gul-i wae geu-rae. eo-di a-peu-nya? son-eu-ro nae i-ma-reul jip-eo-bo-myeo da-geup-ha-ge mul-eot-da.
story.en: The moment he saw my face gone pale, Yongwoo's expression hardened. "What's wrong with your face. Are you sick somewhere?" He pressed his hand to my forehead and asked urgently.

story.text: '병원 갈 정도는 아니에요...' 라고 말끝을 흐리는 사이, 용우는 이미 차 키를 챙기고 있었다. '그건 내가 판단한다. 타.'
story.reading: byeong-won gal jeong-do-neun a-ni-e-yo... ra-go mal-kkeut-eul heu-ri-neun sa-i, yong-u-neun i-mi cha ki-reul chaeng-gi-go iss-eot-da. geu-geon nae-ga pan-dan-han-da. ta.
story.en: "It's not bad enough to go to the hospital..." Before I could even finish the sentence, Yongwoo was already grabbing the car keys. "That's for me to decide. Get in."

story.text: 동네 내과에서 진료를 받자, 의사 선생님은 대수롭지 않다는 듯 웃었다. '체하셨네요. 며칠 죽 위주로 드시고 이 약 드시면 금방 나아요.'
story.reading: dong-ne nae-gwa-e-seo jin-lyo-reul bat-ja, ui-sa seon-saeng-nim-eun dae-su-rop-ji an-ta-neun deut us-eot-da. che-ha-syeot-ne-yo. myeo-chil juk wi-ju-ro deu-si-go i yak deu-si-myeon geum-bang na-a-yo.
story.en: When I saw the doctor at the neighborhood clinic, she smiled like it was nothing much. "You've got indigestion. Stick to porridge for a few days and take this medicine, and you'll be better in no time."

story.text: 옆에서 팔짱을 끼고 듣던 용우가 그제야 안심한 얼굴로 처방전을 받아 들었다. '거봐라, 병원 오길 잘했지.'
story.reading: yeop-e-seo pal-jjang-eul kki-go deut-deon yong-u-ga geu-je-ya an-sim-han eol-gul-lo cheo-bang-jeon-eul bad-a deul-eot-da. geo-bwa-ra, byeong-won o-gil jal-haet-ji.
story.en: Yongwoo, who'd been listening with his arms crossed beside me, finally relaxed and took the prescription slip. "See, told you it was a good idea to come."

story.text: 옆 건물 약국에서 약사가 봉투를 건네며 물었다. '이 소화제는 식후에 드세요. 하루 세 번이요.' 용우가 대신 봉투를 받아 내 가방에 챙겨 넣었다.
story.reading: yeop geon-mul yak-gug-e-seo yak-sa-ga bong-tu-reul geon-ne-myeo mul-eot-da. i so-hwa-je-neun sik-hu-e deu-se-yo. ha-ru se beon-i-yo. yong-u-ga dae-sin bong-tu-reul bad-a nae ga-bang-e chaeng-gyeo neoh-eot-da.
story.en: At the pharmacy next door, the pharmacist handed over a bag and said, "Take this digestive medicine after meals. Three times a day." Yongwoo took the bag for me and tucked it into my bag.

story.text: 숙소로 돌아온 뒤, 그는 죽집에서 사 온 전복죽을 식탁에 놓으며 말했다. '약은 꼭 제때 챙겨 먹어라. 내가 옆에서 매번 확인 못 한다.'
story.reading: suk-so-ro dol-a-on dwi, geu-neun juk-jib-e-seo sa on jeon-bok-jug-eul sik-tag-e noh-eu-myeo mal-haet-da. yag-eun kkok je-ttae chaeng-gyeo meog-eo-ra. nae-ga yeop-e-seo mae-beon hwag-in mot han-da.
story.en: After we got back to the guesthouse, he set down abalone porridge he'd bought from a porridge shop and said, "Make sure you take your medicine on time. I can't check on you every single time."

story.text: 속이 조금씩 편해지는 걸 느끼며, 잔소리 뒤에 숨은 걱정이 이렇게나 컸다는 걸 새삼 느꼈다.
story.reading: sog-i jo-geum-ssik pyeon-hae-ji-neun geol neu-kki-myeo, jan-so-ri dwi-e sum-eun geok-jeong-i i-reo-ke-na keot-da-neun geol sae-sam neu-kkyeot-da.
story.en: As I felt my stomach gradually settle, I realized all over again just how much worry had been hiding behind his nagging.

words.meaning: to have indigestion, to feel sick after eating
words.example_en: I ate too fast, and I think I've got indigestion.
My stomach felt off, so I went and got checked out.
I took the prescription and went to the pharmacy.
After taking the digestive medicine, my stomach felt better.

words.meaning: to take one's medicine (on schedule, without forgetting)
words.example: 하루 세 번 약을 챙겨 먹어야 한다.
words.example_reading: ha-ru se beon yag-eul chaeng-gyeo meog-eo-ya han-da
words.example_en: You need to take your medicine three times a day.

sentences.ko: 급하게 먹었더니 체해서 하루 종일 속이 안 좋았다.
sentences.reading: geup-ha-ge meog-eot-deo-ni che-hae-seo ha-ru jong-il sog-i an jo-at-da
sentences.en: I ate too fast and got indigestion, so my stomach was off all day.

sentences.ko: 몸이 안 좋아서 동네 병원에서 진료를 받았다.
sentences.reading: mom-i an jo-a-seo dong-ne byeong-won-e-seo jin-lyo-reul bad-at-da
sentences.en: I wasn't feeling well, so I got examined at the neighborhood clinic.
I took the prescription and picked up the medicine at the pharmacy.

sentences.ko: 이 소화제는 식후에 하루 세 번 드세요.
sentences.reading: i so-hwa-je-neun sik-hu-e ha-ru se beon deu-se-yo
sentences.en: Take this digestive medicine three times a day after meals.

sentences.ko: 약을 챙겨 먹었더니 금방 몸이 나아졌다.
sentences.reading: yag-eul chaeng-gyeo meog-eot-deo-ni geum-bang mom-i na-a-jyeot-da
sentences.en: I took my medicine as scheduled, and I got better quickly.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.en: What's wrong with your face. Are you sick somewhere?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그냥 속이 좀 안 좋아서요. 병원까지 갈 정도는 아니에요.
turns.reading: geu-nyang sog-i jom an jo-a-seo-yo. byeong-won-kka-ji gal jeong-do-neun a-ni-e-yo.
turns.en: My stomach's just a bit off. It's not bad enough to go to the hospital.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 그건 내가 판단한다. 얼른 타, 병원부터 가자.
turns.reading: geu-geon nae-ga pan-dan-han-da. eol-leun ta, byeong-won-bu-teo ga-ja.
turns.en: That's for me to decide. Get in, we're going to the hospital first.

dialogues.question: 용우가 승객의 만류에도 병원에 데려간 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo took the passenger to the hospital despite her objection?
dialogues.correct_answer: 승객의 상태가 괜찮은지 직접 확인하고 싶어서
options: 승객의 상태가 괜찮은지 직접 확인하고 싶어서
dialogues.explanation: 승객이 괜찮다고 했지만 용우는 그 판단은 자신이 하겠다며 직접 병원에 데려갔습니다.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 이 소화제는 식후에 하루 세 번 먹어야 한다. 알겠지?
turns.reading: i so-hwa-je-neun sik-hu-e ha-ru se beon meog-eo-ya han-da. al-get-ji?
turns.en: You have to take this digestive medicine three times a day after meals. Got it?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 네, 근데 자꾸 깜빡할 것 같아요.
turns.reading: ne, geun-de ja-kku kkam-ppak-hal geot gat-a-yo.
turns.en: Okay, but I feel like I'll keep forgetting.

turns.speaker: 용우
turns.text: 그럼 내가 시간마다 알려줄게. 이번엔 진짜 잘 챙겨 먹어라.
turns.reading: geu-reom nae-ga si-gan-ma-da al-lyeo-jul-ge. i-beon-en jin-jja jal chaeng-gyeo meog-eo-ra.
turns.en: Then I'll remind you every time. Make sure you actually take it this time.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Thanks, I didn't expect you'd look after me this much.

dialogues.question: 용우가 시간마다 알려주겠다고 한 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo offered to remind the passenger every time?
dialogues.correct_answer: 승객이 약 먹는 것을 깜빡할까 봐 걱정돼서
options: 승객이 약 먹는 것을 깜빡할까 봐 걱정돼서
dialogues.explanation: 승객이 약 먹는 것을 깜빡할 것 같다고 하자 용우가 시간마다 알려주겠다고 했습니다.
